underlying_assumptions: Currency conversion fixed at 1 USD = 96.61 INR (Live 2026 Exchange Rate)
Prompt caching read discount assumed at 90% savings (10% of base input rate) where supported
Batch API discount assumed at flat 50% on input and output tokens for async workloads
Latency estimated as Time-to-First-Token + (Output Tokens / Median Tokens-Per-Second)
